description: This PHP source file defines a controller class `SavePayGradeController` within the OrangeHRM system. It handles the preparation of Vue.js components for editing or adding pay grade information based on incoming HTTP requests, specifically setting the correct component and passing the pay grade ID as a property if available.

classes.name: SavePayGradeController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling Vue.js component setup for adding or editing a pay grade.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets the Vue.js component based on whether an existing pay grade ID is provided in the request.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: HTTP request object containing attributes with possible pay grade ID.
